Rules.InvariantScript: "nearest  " & If(IsBlank(Nearest), "-", Nearest.Name & "   gap " & Text(Max(0, Nearest.Gap), "0", "en-US") & " px")

If(IsBlank(NextHit), "no contact on the current heading",
    "contact in " & Text(NextHit.T, "0.0", "en-US") & " ticks (" & Text(NextHit.T * TickMs / 1000, "0.00", "en-US") & " s)  with " & NextHit.Name)
"blocks hit " & gHits & "   paddle saves " & gSaves & "   floor misses " & gMisses
"heading " & HeadingDeg & "°   speed " & gSpeed & " px/tick   tick " & gTick & "   pilot " & If(gAuto, "auto", "manual")
With({a: Radians(-15)}, Set(gDir, {x: gDir.x * Cos(a) - gDir.y * Sin(a), y: gDir.x * Sin(a) + gDir.y * Cos(a)}))
With({a: Radians(15)}, Set(gDir, {x: gDir.x * Cos(a) - gDir.y * Sin(a), y: gDir.x * Sin(a) + gDir.y * Cos(a)}))

"white ball, rim = threat colour (green far, red touching)  ·  dashed cyan ring = sensor range  ·  dashed line + dot = gap to the closest point of the nearest thing  ·  amber ray + ghost = predicted contact on the current heading (relative velocity, so moving blocks and the paddle count)  ·  red pulse = contact this tick"
"slide to move the paddle  ·  the ball has no idea where it is until its sensor sees it"
